gold.custodian: Central Bank of Iraq vault, Baghdad
gold.source_title: Central Bank of Iraq, Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, note 4 'Gold reserve and gold revaluation reserve'
gold.source_quote: Gold reserve at CBI vault 753,950 ... Gold coins at CBI vault 5,926
gold.notes: The note splits the holding into three lines: 'Gold reserve abroad' (IQD 30,733,538m), 'Gold reserve at CBI vault' (IQD 753,950m) and 'Gold coins at CBI vault' (IQD 5,926m). Only the CBI's own vault is named; the note names no institution for the gold held abroad, so no record is filed for that part.

gold.custodian: Central Bank of the Russian Federation vaults, Russia
gold.source_title: Interfax, 'CBR has taken no gold out of Russia, it is all in regulator's storage facilities', quoting the Bank of Russia
gold.source_quote: All gold from our foreign exchange reserves is in CBR vaults in Russian territory.
gold.notes: A statement by the Bank of Russia itself, quoted in the report. The Bank's own Annual Report 2025 says only that the Bank 'has access to the assets in Chinese yuan, gold bars, and foreign cash stored in Russia' - country-level, naming no institution - so the quoted statement is the record.

gold.source_title: Reserve Bank of Malawi, Annual Report and Accounts for the year ended 31 December 2025, note 6 'Gold Reserves'
gold.source_quote: The Bank holds monetary gold on deposit with the Federal Reserve Bank.
gold.notes: The note states the whole holding, 12,836.998 ounces (K95,205 million at 31 December 2025), is on deposit with the Federal Reserve Bank. The note says 'the Federal Reserve Bank' without a city; the Federal Reserve Bank of New York is the Fed's gold custodian, but the document does not name the city, so custodian_hq_city is an inference and the stated wording is kept in custodian_as_stated. 'On deposit with' rather than 'in custody with'.

gold.custodian: Banque Centrale des Comores strongroom, Moroni
gold.source_title: Banque Centrale des Comores, Rapport du commissaire aux comptes et etats financiers au 31 decembre 2024, note 5 'Avoirs en or'
gold.source_quote: Les avoirs en or de 714 Millions KMF au 31 decembre 2024 sont constitues des 18 lingots d'or detenus dans la Serre de Moroni.
gold.notes: The whole holding is 18 gold bars kept in the Bank's own strongroom ('la Serre') in Moroni, the BCC's head office city. The note names the Banque de France only as the source of the year-end gold price, not as a custodian. Accented characters in the quote were transliterated; the original reads 'detenus dans la Serre de Moroni'.
